title: feat: add secure BYOK provider execution and controls
body:
## P5 — BYOK provider execution

Stacked after PR #20 (`completion/advanced-arena`); PRs #17, #18, #19, and #20 remain draft.

- stores provider credentials through Windows Credential Manager/DPAPI and fails closed when OS secure storage is unavailable
- supports OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini HTTPS request/response formats with bounded WinHTTP transport
- requires explicit external-network consent, redacts secrets, and returns only sanitized identity/usage/cost evidence
- enforces dated price snapshots, estimated/actual usage cost, confirmation thresholds, and hard budget ceilings
- adds reachable Settings BYOK configuration, removal, cost-policy, and one-shot generation controls; browser preview stays read-only
- validates with 99 Rust tests, 74 TypeScript tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check, and diff checks via canonical BL4 app_server

P5 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView QA, real provider opt-in smoke, and remote CI.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
